about: Windsor is in southwestern Ontario, on the Detroit River across from Detroit, Michigan. It is Canada’s southernmost major city and a historic auto-manufacturing centre with a compact riverside downtown. The Ambassador Bridge and a tunnel carry heavy cross-border traffic. About 230,000 people live in Windsor.
